Anthropic CEO calls for the AI industry to slow down model development

Dario Amodei published a nearly 4,000-word essay warning that AI capabilities are advancing faster than safety measures can keep up, amid a string of escalating warnings from researchers across the industry.

(https://www.wsj.com/tech/ai/anthropic-boss-warns-ai-industry-must-slow-the-pace-a4267b56)
